whenUse: Browsing the caveman network's offline survival corpus in-app.
Answering 'what can I make with what I have' or 'what growing here stops bleeding'.
whenNot: As a source of the corpus — the store is the source; this is a view of it via `bsc survival`.
For the printable copy — that is `bsc survival compile`, which renders the whole corpus as markdown.
